tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā rā yai/ mchog dang thun mong 'dod dgu'i gru char ni// thugs rje'i sprin las rtsol med 'jo ba yis// rtag tu phongs pa kun gyi gdung sel ma// rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs pad gtsug tu mchod// rmad byung slob dpon 'phags ma'i sras// bla ma'i zhabs kyi rim pa las// skal bzang dpyid du legs 'ongs pa// ngo mtshar sgrub thabs gsal bar 'chad/ de la grub pa'i slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa las 'byung ba bkra shis shing don kun 'grub par byed pa'i sgrol ma rnal 'byor du byed par 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po bla ma las rjes su gnang ba thob cing brtul zhugs la gnas pas/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par maṇ+ḍal gtor mchod sogs mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ rang gi snying gar pad zla la gnas pa'i mam̐ yig ser po'i 'od zer gyis/ 'phags ma sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi sogs nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig ces pa'i bar gyis bdun rnam dag byas la tshogs zhing mi dmigs par bzhag sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā ṇā swā bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems mam̐ yig ser po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bkra shis shing don kun 'grub par byed pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal gser gyi kha dog can/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ rgyab zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po rnams yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa na dung bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na bum pa/ gnyis pa na dpal gyi be'u/ gsum pa na nya/ bzhi pa na gdugs bsnams shing bkra shis par mdzad pa/ lha'i gos sna tshogs pas stod g.yogs dang sham thabs mdzes pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ dpung rgyan/ do shal sogs rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba la mam̐ yig ser po'o// lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo'i sen mo bkab la srin lag nang du bcug ste mthe bong mnan pa ut+pal kha bye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rtag pa/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen tu 'khyil pa las 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ār+ya tā rā maṅga la sarba ar+tha sā dha badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ?/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ yig ser po'i mthar/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog ser po gser btso ma lta bus bskor la/ de las lha sku dang 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/ bkra shis pa'i don thams cad yongs su bsgrubs shing dngos grub mtha' dag thogs med du 'grub par gyur/ ces pa'i spro bsdu yun ring du bsgom/ des skyo na thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad zhu rang la thim/ rang yang thugs ka'i sa bon dang nā da shin tu phra ba'i bar 'dus te de la sems 'dzin/ nā da'ang stong nyid du yal ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag pa la yang yang bslab/ des kyang skyo na ngag bzlas bya ba ni spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gong ltar gsal btab la yi ge bcu gcig pa ci nus su bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i tshad dang phan yon ni rgya gzhung las/ 'bum phrag bzhi'am 'on te drug /'bum phrag bcu yis las kun 'grub// rnal 'byor pa ni gang zhig gis// 'di don nyams su gang len pa// thog ma tha ma med zhi ba'i// sgrol ma yum mchog nyid gyur nas// dngos grub gnyis sogs 'thob 'gyur te// yon tan dpag med 'byung bar gsungs// zhes bshad do// thun 'jog pa na/

thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang rim par 'od du zhu ste thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon mas rim gyis nā da'i bar du 'dus/ de'ang mi dmigs par thim/ de las ldang ba na/ slar rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub sogs dge bsngo bya'o// thun mthar gtor ma 'bul bar spro na bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ sprul pa'i bzhugs gnas lho phyogs gru 'dzin gyi ri bo nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ yi ge bcu gcig pa la/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan bdun dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtso 'khor so sor 'bul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ bcom ldan sgrol ma 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la sogs kyis phrin las zhu/ rgyal ba 'brom rin po ches mdzad par grags pa// 'phags ma sgrol ma dbang phyug ma// chos kyi dbyings las sku phyung la// srid gsum 'gro la thugs rjes zungs// ma ltar byams mdzad lha mo khyod// tshe rabs gong nas bdag gi lha// bdag nyid sgo gsum dad pa yis// lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// gser gyi mdangs can yid 'ong mas// nyon mongs gdung bas nyam thag pa'i// mi zad tsha gdung bsal du gsol// pad+ma'i zhabs gdan dpa' gcig mo// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// ma rig mun par rab 'thums pa'i// mi shes drwa ba bcad du gsol// dpal ldan ma gcig lha yi lha// rin chen du ma'i do shal can// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la 'dud// bdag ni thog med dus ring nas// las kyi rlung gis rab bdas shing*// ngan 'gro mu mtha' med 'khyams te// blo mig mun pas bsgribs lags na// da ni 'phags ma thugs rje can// bdag cag rnams kyi mig mdzad la// yong ye de 'dra'i sdug bsngal las// skyob par mdzod cig skyabs gcig ma// deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// gang du skye dang skye ba der// ma gcig khyed dang mjal bar shog

/ces pas bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba rtse gcig gdab/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan zhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥs gshegs la bkra shis brjod/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba sogs cho ga'i rim pa rgyas pa la dga' na sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rigs mthun gzhan ltar bya chog par gsungs/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin par 'dod pas bdag bskyed las kha spos te mdun bum sgrub pa dang*/ rjes gnang dngos kyi bya ba rnams ni sgrol dkar gyi yi ge zla ba 'dod 'jo nyid kha spos pas tshang la ma 'khrul ba 'grub pa yin no// //nyes tshogs smrig rgyu'i phreng ba bcom pa dang*// dge legs mthong na dga' ster skyed mos tshal// grub gnyis gser gyi snye mas dud byed pa// 'phags ma rdzogs ldan sprin gyi bla bre'i spun// sgrub thabs rtsa ba'i gzhung gi rjes 'brangs pa// 'di byas dge bas dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs// rtag brtan mdzad pa'i phrin las mkha' mthar khyab// bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bka' lung gser gyi me tog gtsug tu bcings nas/ ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus/ dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i tshes bzang por rje btsun e waṃ pa'i ring lugs dri ma med par 'dzin pa'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
